def choose_move(observation):
    agent_state = observation.get('agent', {})
    position = agent_state.get('position', (0, 0))
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    enemies = observation.get('enemies', [])
    territory = observation.get('territory', {})
    border = territory.get('border', [])

    targets = resources or enemies or border

    if targets:
        target = min(targets, key=lambda t: abs(t[0]-position[0]) + abs(t[1]-position[1]))
        dx = (target[0] - position[0])
        dy = (target[1] - position[1])
        dx = (dx > 0) - (dx < 0)
        dy = (dy > 0) - (dy < 0)
        return [dx, dy]
    else:
        # move randomly in a safe direction
        # check for enemies to avoid
        threat_positions = [enemy.get('position', (0,0)) for enemy in enemies]
        # move away from closest threat
        if threat_positions:
            closest_threat = min(threat_positions, key=lambda t: abs(t[0]-position[0]) + abs(t[1]-position[1]))
            dx = position[0] - closest_threat[0]
            dy = position[1] - closest_threat[1]
            dx = (dx > 0) - (dx < 0)
            dy = (dy > 0) - (dy < 0)
            return [dx, dy]
        else:
            # no threats, move randomly
            return [0, 1]
